pages.text: Chests, barrels, shulker boxes and ender chests open their usual screens on the wagon. Adjacent cargo chests do not merge.$(br2)Conversion between blocks and an entity preserves cargo positions and container contents. Menus may close during conversion; reopen them afterward.

Unloading or destroying an ordinary container drops its block and contents separately. Shulker boxes retain their contents; ender chests still access your personal storage.$(br2)Some modded chests and barrels also work. Custom containers are not universally supported, and locked or unresolved loot containers may reject interaction.
